questions_covered: startup waits; threshold portability; retained q50 stability; first-key tails; failures; resources; partial pattern wait actionability
first_run_artifact: Real Performance Tests topology artifact with raw retained samples, q25/q50/q75/cnt, first-key distributions, failures, resources, environment metadata, and per-run order.
separate_followup_if: CI ordering, variance, failures, first-key tails, or resource placement differs from local rows.

questions_covered: Site Editor and Post Editor pattern-loading sleeps; preview/canvas behavior; resource quiet; fallback policy
first_run_artifact: Per-spec readiness/resource artifact with source-specific predicates, timeout/fallback logs, retained samples, preview/canvas/actionability counts, and lane metadata.
separate_followup_if: Readiness differs by spec/lane or moves resources into the measured window.

questions_covered: selector/source guards; prerequisite for store partition; aggregate p50 eligibility
first_run_artifact: Focused behavior fixtures plus source-span microscope for the next hot owner, followed by matched aggregate p50 only after behavior and source spans pass.
separate_followup_if: Behavior gates fail, source-span fanout does not collapse, or the aggregate win appears without source evidence.

questions_covered: runtime mechanism; CPU/QoS mechanism; key-window joins; observer overhead
first_run_artifact: Unprivileged helper/key-window/renderer/collector/command schema with clock sync and no root collectors.
separate_followup_if: Join coverage or class ordering fails, or the sidecar perturbs the row ordering.

first_run_artifact: Compact sidecar-accepted manifest under root powermetrics, with root trace only if counters do not separate rows.
separate_followup_if: Powermetrics cannot separate classes or trace overhead changes ordering.

questions_covered: representative product workload; external glyph/display timing; claim expansion beyond fixed-x and Chromium-internal endpoints
first_run_artifact: Replay strata and external calibration only for product-latency, semantic-glyph, presented-frame, or hardware-display claims.
separate_followup_if: The report needs product or display claims and the current benchmark artifact is no longer enough.
